name: 2026 Forms 1099 request.eml
subject: HANGS General Contracting 2026 Forms 1099
body:
Hi,

Attached are the 2026 vendor payments by vendor, the vendor master with each vendor's W-9 status and the accounts payable ledger by account. Please prepare the 2026 Forms 1099-NEC and the transmittal summary for us to review; we file electronically.

The payments file is the final year-end export from accounts payable. A few things to look at:

- Ridgeline Concrete Cutting never sent a W-9. We started backup withholding in April after the third request.
- TIN Matching came back with no match for Cedar Hollow Tile in October. We asked for a new W-9 and have not heard back.
- Tomas Arvelo is still on our list from the Q3 941 review; we have not decided whether he should have been on payroll.
- The September settlement went to the claimant's attorney, and our office rent is paid to the landlord's LLC. I assume those are 1099-MISC, not NEC.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS General Contracting LP
